card.name: Blog post bylines and navigation text
card.fires_on: Small words and digits in blog page furniture, such as 'by' after a post date, parts of the date, 'Leave a Comment', and 'Next' or 'Previous' post links. It fires where the post header or footer ends and the article text begins.

modes.label: Byline and date
modes.description: The word 'by' or a date piece (comma, year digit) in a post header just before the article starts.

modes.label: Footer navigation
modes.description: 'Next', 'Previous' or 'Leave a Comment' at the end of a blog post.
modes.example: Thanks for reading. <<Next>> & Previous articles in series:

card.plain: It marks the blog header and footer text around an article, like the date line, byline, comment link and next/previous links.
